verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs state that Terminal ships official SDKs for iOS, Android and React Native for building a custom POS. They also document Tap to Pay contactless acceptance on iPhone and Android through the Terminal SDK, versioned SDK migration guides, a built-in simulated reader for testing, and SDK-level offline payment forwarding. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the iOS/Android SDKs specifically (community comments praise terminal-level API integration but not the mobile SDKs), and no GitHub evidence for the native mobile SDK repos (only the JS SDK).

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed in-person payments into my own iOS or Android app with official mobile SDKs

citations.quote: Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
Accept contactless payments using a compatible iPhone or Android device with the Stripe Terminal SDK.
Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Learn how to migrate to version 6.0.0 of the Stripe Terminal SDK.
Use Tap to Pay on iPhone to accept in-person contactless payments with a compatible iPhone.
